programmes.d: A recently released convict jeopardizes his parole when he sets out to kill Matt.
Peter Scooper starts a feud between his family and the Galloways when he takes potatoes from the Galloway farm.
A man who loses his farm to creditors finds a job in Dodge City, only to lose his heart to one of Kitty's saloon girls.
Kitty risks herself to stop an attempted murder.
Whether blood is thicker than water is put to a test when Marshal Dillon asks a killer's nephew to help him bring in a wanted man.
A notorious gunfighter comes to Dodge, making the townspeople curious as to who he's after.
Matt Dillon runs into an old flame when he rides into an outlaw hideout.
Dodge City's epic lawman, Marshal Dillon, saddles up to save a teenaged boy out to avenge his mother's murder at the hands of a ruthless gang of outlaws.
Matt discovers that an old girlfriend is working on the opposite side of the law.
Matt discovers that he was the intended victim of a murder he is investigating.
An embittered lawman seeks revenge against the men who destroyed his town and took away his wife.
A dance-hall girl manipulates her admirers into facing each other in gunfights.
A girl refuses to testify against the robbers who kidnapped her.
A ranch hand is accused of stealing a horse by his former boss.
Farmer Jed Hackett decides it is time his three sons marry the women they brought back from Dodge.
A widower tries to protect the reputation of his son's teacher, and faces a charge of murder because of it.
Matt and Chester find a burnt-down shack and a girl who claims her father died in the blaze.
A former gunslinger is goaded into a duel by his fiancee's brother.
A coffin at a funeral is found to be filled with rocks.
A robber holds up a stagecoach carrying Matt, then turns up in Dodge.
Matt traps a cattleman who shot two homesteaders.
A man nearly kills a couple on their way to Dodge.
After eight years in prison, embittered Collie Patten is unable to adjust to the changes he finds when he returns home.

A small, ornery Irishman named O'Quillian spreads dissension and disaster in Dodge City.
Matt Dillon sets out to rescue a white girl from an Indian band but finds she's not sure she wants to be rescued.
A woman named Minnie Higgins falls in love with Doc.
A woman claims to have killed her outlaw son to prevent him from turning himself in.
Dillon backs a citizen who refuses to sell land to a railroad builder, so the builder buys liquor for his large crews causing drunken riots in Dodge.
An outlaw's return to his homestead to claim some hidden loot leads to nothing but trouble.
Matt hunts down the Indians who are killing settlers.
Matt Dillon tries to bring a man to justice despite the onslaughts of an almost maniacal man wishing to exact his own revenge.
The mother of two infamous outlaw sons, against great odds, tries to steer her youngest boy into an honest life.
